verdict.rationale: GoDaddy's own Domains API docs list transfers as a supported operation, and transfer is a commercial mutation that requires a quoteToken, which implies a priced quote before transfer. Beyond that, the evidence only names the capability and does not document the transfer-in flow itself. missing for 10: EPP/auth-code flow documentation, transfer status tracking, explicit transfer cost details, handling of remaining registration time, independent/hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, transferring domains IN is documented and honest — EPP/auth-code flow, status tracking, what the transfer costs, and what happens to remaining registration time
